desc: Ideation: exploit monotonicity of the composed rating function and choose a forward query-only lazy segment tree approach.
Parse input, store contests and queries, build sorted unique query initial ratings, and create a mapping from each query value to its compressed index.
Implement an iterative lazy segment tree over the compressed query points with range_add and find_first_ge, using segment maxima and dummy leaves set to a very negative value.
Process contests in original order: for each [L,R], compute l = find_first_ge(L), r = find_first_ge(R+1), and if l < r apply range_add(l, r, 1).
Push all pending lazy values to leaves, retrieve final ratings for compressed query points, and output answers in the original query order.
Validate on samples and edge cases such as a single unique query, no effective updates, all queries updated every contest, and maximum initial rating 500000.
